## Validation

- [ ] Python tests pass for shared-core changes.
- [ ] Frontend build and browser checks pass for desktop/web UI changes.
- [ ] Android changes were validated with the documented Flet toolchain or are explicitly marked unverified.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots and supported-window-size notes.
- [ ] No credentials, API keys, private course data, or AI conversation content are included.
- [ ] Architecture and release-channel boundaries remain clear.
